objective: Find observed matching Payday dice reward details and timestamp if available; exclude MarioWiki and mirrored explanations.

Title: Payday Triple Dice - Super Mario Wiki, the Mario encyclopedia
URL: https://www.mariowiki.com/Payday_Triple_Dice
Published: 2026-08-08T00:00:00.000Z
Author: N/A
Highlights:
| Payday Triple Dice | |
| --- | --- |
| | |
| Description | |
| Triple Dice that get you coins equal to the roll. | |
| First appearance | Super Mario Party Jamboree (2024) |
| Latest appearance | Super Mario Party Jamboree – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Jamboree TV (2025) |
| Effect | Allows the player to roll three Dice Blocks, with the total being how many coins the player receives. |
| Variant of | Triple Dice |

The Payday Triple Dice is an item in Super Mario Party Jamboree. It is a more powerful variant of the Payday Double Dice, being a set of three solid gold dice. This item allows the player to roll three Dice Blocks (much like a Triple Dice), with the player receiving coins equal to the total amount rolled (much like the Plus Block from the first Mario Party). The player can potentially get 3-30 free coins with the Payday Triple Dice, along with an additional 20 coin bonus for matching numbers or 50 coin bonus for matching sevens similar to the Triple Dice. 

Mario's Jamboree Buddy ability dice roll also adds to the total amount of coins for a maximum of 79 coins (with a roll of matching sevens for 21 coins, the 50 coin bonus, and an 8 from Mario).
...
- If bought for the regular price of 15 coins, the Payday Triple Dice have a 65.2% chance of paying for themselves — a 64.8% chance of rolling at least a 15 (as noted on the Triple Dice page) and a 0.4% chance of rolling a triple 1-4 for a 20 coin bonus.
